# nex-typed

> nex-typed is a zero-dependency, TypeScript-native browser library for creating terminal-style typing animations. The entire public API is a single function `createTyped(target, options)` that returns a `NexTypedController` for runtime control (start, pause, resume, stop, destroy, backspace, skip, goTo, setSpeed, etc.). It supports multiple strings, custom blinking cursors, backspace/delete effects, loops, human-like timing, speed curves, shuffle, and 10+ callback hooks. ESM only, targets ES2023 + DOM APIs, ~2.8KB gzipped.

## Installation

```bash
npm install nex-typed
# or
pnpm add nex-typed
# or
yarn add nex-typed
```

## Minimal Usage

```typescript
import { createTyped } from 'nex-typed';

const controller = createTyped('#terminal', {
  strings: ['Hello World!', 'Welcome to nex-typed.'],
  typeSpeed: 50,
  cursor: { enabled: true, char: '▌' },
});

controller.start();
```

HTML:

```html
<div id="terminal"></div>
```

## Core API

### `createTyped(target, options): NexTypedController`

- `target`: `HTMLElement | string` (CSS selector or DOM element)
- `options`: `NexTypedOptions` (see below)
- Returns: `NexTypedController` (see below)

Throws if the selector resolves to no element.

### `NexTypedOptions`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `strings` | `string[]` | (required) | Strings to type sequentially |
| `typeSpeed` | `number` | `50` | Ms per character (lower = faster) |
| `startDelay` | `number` | `0` | Delay before first character (ms) |
| `cursor` | `CursorOptions` | — | Cursor config (see below) |
| `backspaceSpeed` | `number` | `30` | Ms per character when backspacing |
| `deleteStrings` | `boolean` | `false` | Auto-delete each string after typing |
| `deleteDelay` | `number` | `1000` | Delay before auto-delete (ms) |
| `loop` | `boolean` | `false` | Restart from first string after completion |
| `humanTypeDelay` | `{min:number;max:number}` | — | Random per-char delay; fully replaces `typeSpeed` (still affected by `speedProfile` and `pauseOnPunctuation`) |
| `stringPauseDelay` | `number` | `500` | Delay between strings (ms) |
| `pauseOnPunctuation` | `boolean` | `false` | +200ms after `. ! ? ，。！？` |
| `typeSpeedVariance` | `number` | `0` | ±N% random speed variation (0-100) |
| `shuffle` | `boolean` | `false` | Randomize string order (re-shuffles each loop) |
| `speedProfile` | `'linear'\|'easeIn'\|'easeOut'\|'easeInOut'` | `'linear'` | Typing speed curve |
| `onBegin` | `() => void` | — | Animation starts |
| `onStringStart` | `(index, text) => void` | — | A string begins typing |
| `onStringEnd` | `(index, text) => void` | — | A string finishes typing |
| `onComplete` | `() => void` | — | All strings done (not called in loop mode) |
| `onPause` | `(index, charIndex) => void` | — | Paused |
| `onResume` | `(index, charIndex) => void` | — | Resumed |
| `onBackspaceStart` | `(index, text) => void` | — | Backspace/delete begins |
| `onBackspaceEnd` | `(index, text) => void` | — | Backspace/delete ends |
| `onLoop` | `(index) => void` | — | Loop restarts (`index` = just-completed string) |
| `onShuffle` | `(original, shuffled) => void` | — | Strings shuffled |

### `CursorOptions`

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `boolean` | (required) | Show cursor |
| `char` | `string` | `\|` | Cursor character |
| `blink` | `boolean` | `true` | Blink cursor |
| `blinkSpeed` | `number` | `500` | Ms between on/off |
| `blinkCount` | `number` | `0` | Number of blinks; `0` = infinite; stays visible after |
| `hideWhenComplete` | `boolean` | `false` | Hide cursor when animation completes |
| `style` | `string \| Partial<CSSStyleDeclaration>` | — | CSS class name (string) OR inline styles object (camelCase keys → kebab-case) |

### `NexTypedController` methods

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `start()` | Begin animation. No-op if already running. Mounts cursor. |
| `pause()` | Pause (hides cursor). Resumable with `resume()`. |
| `resume()` | Resume from paused state. Restarts blinking. |
| `stop()` | Halt immediately. Hides cursor, clears timers. **Not cleanly resumable** — `start()` after `stop()` leaves inconsistent state. To restart, `destroy()` and create a new controller. |
| `destroy()` | Full cleanup: removes DOM elements, clears all timers. Cannot restart. |
| `backspace()` | Manually trigger backspace on current string (uses `backspaceSpeed`). No-op if not running/paused or already backspacing. |
| `deleteString()` | Delete entire current string, then advance to next. |
| `skip()` | Instantly show full current string, trigger `onStringEnd`, advance. |
| `goTo(index)` | Jump to string at `index` (0-based). Invalid indices silently ignored. Clears text, waits `stringPauseDelay`, then types from first char. |
| `getTypeSpeed()` | Returns current typing speed (ms). |
| `setSpeed(speed)` | Dynamically change typing speed (ms per char). Affects subsequent characters. |
| `getCursorBlinkSpeed()` | Returns current cursor blink speed (ms). |
| `setCursorBlinkSpeed(speed)` | Dynamically change blink speed. Updates immediately if blinking. |

## DOM Structure

```
[target element]
└── [span data-nex-typed-root]
    ├── [span data-nex-typed-text] (typed text content)
    └── [span data-nex-typed-cursor] (optional cursor, aria-hidden)
```

## Critical Notes

- **Browser-only**: Uses `document`, `window.setTimeout`, `window.setInterval`. No SSR/Node.js support without a DOM shim.
- **Always destroy()**: Call `destroy()` when done (e.g. in React `useEffect` cleanup, Vue `onUnmounted`, Svelte `onDestroy`) to prevent timer/DOM leaks.
- **pause() vs stop()**: Use `pause()`/`resume()` for temporary halts. `stop()` cannot be cleanly resumed — to restart, `destroy()` and create a new controller.
- **No framework dependency**: Vanilla TS. Works with React, Vue, Svelte, Angular via standard lifecycle hooks.
- **ESM only**: Package exports are ESM. Target: ES2023 + DOM lib.
- **Cursor `style` object**: Keys are camelCase CSS properties (e.g. `{ color: 'red', fontWeight: 'bold' }`), converted to kebab-case and applied via `style.setProperty`. String value = CSS class name added via `classList.add`.

## Framework Integration Patterns

### React

```typescript
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { createTyped } from 'nex-typed';

function TypingComponent() {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ref.current) return;
    const controller = createTyped(ref.current, {
      strings: ['Hello React!'],
      typeSpeed: 50,
    });
    controller.start();
    return () => controller.destroy();
  }, []);
  return <div ref={ref} />;
}
```

### Vue 3

```typescript
import { onMounted, onUnmounted, ref } from 'vue';
import { createTyped } from 'nex-typed';

const terminal = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null);
let controller;
onMounted(() => {
  if (terminal.value) {
    controller = createTyped(terminal.value, { strings: ['Hello Vue!'], typeSpeed: 50 });
    controller.start();
  }
});
onUnmounted(() => controller?.destroy());
```

### Svelte

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import { createTyped } from 'nex-typed';
  let terminal: HTMLElement;
  let controller;
  onMount(() => {
    controller = createTyped(terminal, { strings: ['Hello Svelte!'], typeSpeed: 50 });
    controller.start();
  });
  onDestroy(() => controller?.destroy());
</script>
<div bind:this={terminal}></div>
```
